tools.name: token-due-diligence_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a token contract on Base Mainnet including bytecode, ERC-20 metadata, owner, proxy status, and privileges. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/token-due-diligence/analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: token-due-diligence_liquidity
tools.description: Inspect supported DEX liquidity pools on Base Mainnet using official Uniswap V2 and V3 factories. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/token-due-diligence/liquidity. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: token-due-diligence_holders
tools.description: Analyze holder concentration from transfer events when complete transfer history is available on Base Mainnet. Price $0.10 USDC. POST /api/v1/token-due-diligence/holders. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: token-due-diligence_honeypot
tools.description: Check if a token is a honeypot using Honeypot.is simulation, including buy/sell tax, gas information, and contract verification. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/token-due-diligence/honeypot. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "token-due-diligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: token-due-diligence_honeypot · Private data: token-due-diligence_analyze, token-due-diligence_liquidity, token-due-diligence_holders, token-due-diligence_permissions, token-due-diligence_honeypot, token-due-diligence_security-report · Public sink: token-due-diligence_analyze, token-due-diligence_liquidity, token-due-diligence_holders, token-due-diligence_permissions, token-due-diligence_honeypot, token-due-diligence_security-report · Destructive: token-due-diligence_analyze, token-due-diligence_liquidity, token-due-diligence_holders, token-due-diligence_permissions, token-due-diligence_honeypot, token-due-diligence_security-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
